instruction: Draft only from extracted source text. Every generated field must carry a verbatim source quote. If a fact, effective date, applicability or impact is not stated or cannot be supported, say 'Not stated in source' or do not publish.

formats.title: {authority}: {update_type} — {plain_language_subject}
formats.summary: State only what the official document changes, introduces, clarifies, extends or consults on. Do not add context not in the source.
formats.takeaway: State the directly supported action for the affected entity. If no action is stated, say: 'Review the official document to determine applicability and required action.'
formats.effective_date: Use a date only where expressly stated in the source; otherwise output exactly: Not stated in source
